summary.en: Iran-backed suspects have been accused of plotting attacks on a U.K. base that hosts U.S. jets and of a drone strike on the Khor Mor gas field in Iraqi Kurdistan, which halted production and cut power. Iraqi security officials linked the Khor Mor attack to internal disputes and announced new details about the incident, while a security chief disclosed plans to expand air-defence deployments. Iraqi authorities arrested a suspect accused of killing his brother in Shamamak and a delegation is being sent to Lebanon after the body of former MP Ahmed al-Alwani was found there. The conflict has resulted in 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Irans støttede mistenkte er blitt anklaget for å ha planlagt angrep på en britisk base som huser amerikanske fly, og for et droneangrep på gassfeltet Khor Mor i irakisk Kurdistan, som stoppet produksjonen og kuttet strømmen. Iraks sikkerhetsmyndigheter knyttet Khor Mor-angrepet til interne stridigheter og kunngjorde nye detaljer om hendelsen, mens en sikkerhetssjef avslørte planer om å utvide luftvernsutplasseringene. Iraks myndigheter arresterte en mistenkt som er anklaget for å ha drept sin bror i Shamamak, og en delegasjon blir sendt til Libanon etter at kroppen til den tidligere stortingsrepresentanten Ahmed al-Alwani ble funnet der. Konflikten har ført til 396 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
